snippet.title: MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme is the new game by Morbidware in collaboration with Stockholm Kartell.

A desperate attempt to endure the coming Apocalypse in a cursed, unjust dark fantasy world, made only to appease a vain god. Combat is brutal, choices are lethal, and survival is a temporary insult to fate. A flail to the face.

Wishlist on Steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216800/MRK_BORG_Heresy_Supreme/

Official website
https://www.morbidwaregames.com

Music by Cani dei Portici
https://linktr.ee/canideiportici

Sound Design & Mix by Valerio Baiocchi 
https://www.instagram.com/valeriomaina/

MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme is a game by Morbidware
